summary: SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC_v1 passes QA with 6 minor warnings and 0 blockers. All 5 pipeline files reviewed (spec.json pending assembly). Cross-file threading validated: 30 TSK_WDCL_* IDs in sop_modules match 30 rates in production. Single SF-based paintable item (ITM_WOOD_CEILING_PANEL). Combined prime+paint with primer conditional on substrate_state. 5 substrate-driven primer systems + 3 QT-driven finish systems, all reusing existing SYS_ IDs. Ceiling style complexity modifier (flat_plank/beadboard/tongue_and_groove/coffered) correctly modeled with effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. ALL work is overhead — base rates ~0.70-0.80x of equivalent SF_WOOD_WALL_NC rates. Height varies per room via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND — applies ON TOP of overhead base rates. 5 protection zones (floor_full, floor_perimeter, wall_upper_band, fixture_covers, opening_cover_lightweight) all properly paired setup/teardown. Inverse protection relationship to SF_WOOD_WALL_NC confirmed: wood ceiling masks wall below (wall_upper_band), wood wall masks ceiling above (ceiling_line). Sheen/QT gate compatible (QT3+satin default — no tension). Human Feedback Gate has NOT occurred — expected for v0.1.0 draft.

issues.description: Wood ceiling SF production rates are research estimates with overhead penalty applied. No canonical doctrine provides wood-ceiling-specific SF rates. Spray 130 SF/hr and brush 50 SF/hr derived from SF_WOOD_WALL_NC rates (175 and 70 SF/hr respectively) with overhead penalty (0.75x spray, 0.70x brush). Overhead penalty varies by task type: spray ~0.75x, brush ~0.70x, sanding ~0.75x, caulk ~0.70x.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. Rates are reasonable derivations from wood wall rates with documented overhead penalty factors. Differentiation of penalty by task type (spray vs brush) is appropriate — brush overhead is more fatiguing. Refine after field testing.

issues.description: Ceiling style modifiers (beadboard=1.15x, tongue_and_groove=1.10x, coffered=1.35x) are adapted from Millwork Doctrine §7.2 complexity categories. Doctrine does not explicitly define modifiers for ceiling-specific styles. Coffered (1.35x) is higher than library_panel wall (1.25x) — justified by beam faces, inside corners, and multiple orientation changes.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable adaptations based on board/joint/beam complexity. Field validation recommended. Consider updating Millwork Doctrine §7.2 to explicitly include ceiling style complexity modifiers.

doctrine_compliance.millwork_nc_paint_doctrine: Compliant. MDF two-step prime enforced (edge seal with shellac/oil-based BEFORE latex face primer — separate mandatory task TSK_WDCL_SEAL_MDF_EDGES). FJP stain-blocking mandatory (SYS_PRIMER_POPLAR_STAINBLOCK). Hardwood tannin-blocking (SYS_PRIMER_HARDWOOD_TANNINBLOCK). Complexity modifiers adapted from §7.2. SF-based measurement from §1.1.
doctrine_compliance.fine_finish_doctrine: Compliant. Combined prime+paint with conditional primer. Interstage universal at all QTs with correct sanding discipline per tier (QT3=spot, QT4=full 220, QT5=thorough 220-320). QT5 brush 3+ coats (ROUND_WDCL_3FINISH). Material systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). Sheen/QT gate enforced. Waterborne philosophy documented (apply, tip once, walk away).
doctrine_compliance.modifier_registry: Compliant. Height varies per room via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND (H1=1.0, H2=1.30, H3=1.50, H4=2.00) — applies ON TOP of overhead base rates. QT modifiers on qt_scaled tasks only (QT3=1.0, QT4=1.3, QT5=1.5). ceiling_style modifier applied as time multiplier (effective_rate = base_rate / modifier). NOT applied to protection, cleanup, or FIXED tasks.
doctrine_compliance.protection_and_masking_doctrine: Compliant. 5 protection zones, all properly conditioned. Floor full for spray, perimeter for brush. Wall upper band masking spray-conditional. Fixture masking always (embedded in ceiling surface). Opening covers spray-conditional. All zones have paired setup/teardown tasks. Key distinction: wall_upper_band is the inverse of wood wall's ceiling_line — ceiling masks wall below, wall masks ceiling above.
doctrine_compliance.materials_and_consumables_doctrine: Compliant. CON_ prefix throughout (no CONS_). Elevated spackle consumption documented for board-style ceilings (high fastener density). Overfill-sand-flush method referenced. Thicker-consistency caulk for overhead. All consumable categories valid (protection, abrasive, tool, applicator, prep, fill_material).
doctrine_compliance.conventions: Compliant. CON_ prefix. task_classification (never task_class). Severity: critical/major/minor. Phase values: setup/prep/prime/interstage/finish/cleanup (no 'protect' or 'protection'). All units uppercase (SF, EA, SHEET, ROLL, TUBE, QT). Input IDs canonical: IN_EA_ROOMS_TOTAL, IN_SF_PROTECT_FLOOR_PERIMETER, IN_SF_FLOOR_VACUUM_AREA. No prohibited patterns detected.

key_characteristics: First spec with ALL overhead work — every task performed above head. Base rates ~0.70-0.80x of equivalent wood wall rates, baked into base rates (NOT a separate modifier).
5 protection zones (most of any spec so far): floor_full (spray), floor_perimeter (brush), wall_upper_band (spray), fixture_covers (always), opening_cover_lightweight (spray). vs wood wall's 2 zones.
Inverse protection relationship to SF_WOOD_WALL_NC: ceiling masks wall below (wall_upper_band), wall masks ceiling above (ceiling_line).
Fixture masking ALWAYS required — ceiling fixtures embedded in work surface. Unlike wall specs where ceiling fixtures are above the work zone.
Ceiling style modifier: flat_plank(1.0x), beadboard(1.15x), tongue_and_groove(1.10x), coffered(1.35x). Coffered is highest complexity modifier in the system (library_panel wall is 1.25x).
30 tasks total (22 binary, 8 qt_scaled) — most tasks of any single-item spec due to 5 protection zones with setup/teardown pairs.
Coffered beam faces are IN SCOPE — beams and panels form integrated ceiling system. Standalone beams excluded (SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC).
Height modifier stacking: overhead_base × (1/height_modifier) × (ceiling_style) × (1/QT_modifier for qt_scaled). H3 coffered QT5 is the slowest production scenario.
Single paintable item ITM_WOOD_CEILING_PANEL (SF) — same single-item pattern as SF_WOOD_WALL_NC, SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC.
Proposed new surface_id 'ceiling_panel' following wall_panel/wainscot_panel pattern (distinct from ceiling_field for drywall).
All 8 material system IDs reuse existing entries — 5 primer SYS_ + 3 finish SYS_ — REUSE OVER CREATION.
QT3+satin default has no sheen/QT gate tension.
review_notes: Wood ceiling spec is well-structured and closely follows SF_WOOD_WALL_NC patterns while correctly adapting for overhead work specifics. Overhead penalty is consistently applied across all task types with appropriate differentiation (spray ~0.75x, brush ~0.70x, caulk ~0.70x). Protection zones are comprehensive — 5 zones vs wood wall's 2 — reflecting the different geometry of overhead work (overspray falls down, not up). Fixture masking correctly identified as always-required (embedded in ceiling surface). Inverse protection relationship (wall_upper_band vs ceiling_line) is logically correct. Coffered ceiling inclusion is a good design decision — keeps the ceiling as a self-contained system. No critical or major issues found. 6 minor warnings are all documentation/field-validation items, not structural problems.
